services.desc: Join us for a day of haddock and groundfishing off the coast of New England - a true Northeast fishing tradition that’s perfect for anglers of all ages and skill levels. These trips are all about steady action, tasty catches, and time well spent on the water. From early spring through late fall, the deep offshore banks of Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and southern Maine offer outstanding bottom fishing for a variety of delicious species. Our primary target is haddock - prized for its flaky white meat and found in abundance on offshore structures and ledges.
